annotations.title: What changed in one Candor UI item

description: What changed in one item between two released versions, from facts only, to plan an update and write its PR: props added, removed or retyped, exports and LocaleProvider string keys added or removed, and files touched, from each release's API record; then the CHANGELOG entries in the range that name the item or its exports. Plain words first, then the same as JSON. Records start at 2.7.0: for an earlier version it says "not recorded before 2.7.0" and what is known from the first recorded release on, never a guess. `from` is the version the project has (candor-lock.json records it), and defaults to the one the server URL passes (`?kit=`, written by `npx candor-ui mcp`); `to` defaults to the latest. Example arguments: { "item": "plan", "from": "2.7.0", "to": "2.8.0" }

from.description: The version installed, e.g. "2.7.0" (candor-lock.json records it). Default: the version the server's URL passes (`?kit=`), which `npx candor-ui mcp` writes from the lockfile.

to.description: The version to compare with. Default: the latest.

name: item_changes
title: What changed in one Candor UI item between two versions
